You are working on Scotty itself (this repo). Read AGENTS.md, docs/design.md and container/AGENTS.md first and follow their rules. The owner authorizes changes under ui/ for this work. Don't touch docs/plan.md.

Start by running `.agents/setup`. It installs Node and dependencies and starts the UI dev server on port 4173 with a seed API (real event logs through the real fold), then prints a Ready URL. Install Playwright 1.63.0 in /workspace/.scotty/capture for screenshots and video.

Two tasks, in this order:

1. A message queue in the session view, for both Codex and Claude sessions.
   Today, sending a message while the agent is working only shows "Queued" (ui/src/routes/s.$sessionId.tsx around line 122). The queued text disappears, and you can't see, edit, reorder, remove or force-send it.
   Build:
   - A clean, minimal bar directly above the composer, matching the existing style. One queued message shows "1 message queued" with the message text muted beside it (one line, truncated), plus a pencil (edit) and an × (remove).
   - With several queued messages, the bar expands to a list you can reorder (drag, plus up/down buttons for touch), where each message can be edited or removed.
   - "Send now" on a queued message interrupts the current turn and sends that message immediately.
   - It works at phone width (375px) and on desktop.
   Find where queued steers live today (the Session DO, src/session/fold.ts, src/session/agents/*). If the queue needs to be server state, keep the DO rules: intent events, a pure fold, and unit tests in fold's tests for every new event. Don't keep the queue only in the browser if it has to survive a reload.

2. The live preview in the side panel (ui/src/components/SidePanel.tsx, the preview-frame iframe).
   The preview host is <port>-<id>.<base> behind Cloudflare Access. In the iframe, Access answers 302 to the team-domain login page, which refuses to be framed, so the panel is blank. The open-in-new-tab link works.
   Find a fix so the iframe shows the preview when the owner is signed in to Scotty. Read deploy/deployer.ts (the Access apps) and the DO fetch in src/session/object.ts (the preview proxy).
   If the fix needs a Cloudflare change, make it in deploy/deployer.ts. You can't deploy from here, so write down in docs/design.md why the fix works, and say exactly what the owner must deploy and check. If the iframe can't work at all, the panel should say why and offer the new-tab link, not show a blank frame.

Proof. Show the owner, in this chat, that the work actually works:
- Screenshots at 375px and desktop width of: one queued message, several queued messages, editing a message, reordering, and send-now. Attach each with `scotty-attach <file>`.
- At least one short video (a Playwright recording) of queue, edit, reorder and send-now working. Attach it too.
- Run npm run fmt, lint, typecheck, ui:build and test, and report the results. The e2e tests need a deployment; say they didn't run.

Commit in small pieces on your session branch and push it. Don't open a PR and don't merge. End with a summary: what changed, which files, what you proved, and what the owner still has to deploy or check.

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# The dev environment for a Scotty session (container/AGENTS.md): the pinned Node, dependencies,
# then the UI dev server on 4173 with its seed API. Idempotent; run it again after a resume.
set -euo pipefail
cd "$(dirname "$0")/.."

node_version="$(tr -d '[:space:]' < .nvmrc)"
port=4173

# 1. The Node .nvmrc pins, linked into /usr/local/bin.
if [[ "$(node --version 2>/dev/null || true)" != "v${node_version}" ]]; then
  case "$(uname -m)" in
    x86_64) arch=x64 ;;
    aarch64 | arm64) arch=arm64 ;;
    *) echo "No Node build for $(uname -m)" >&2; exit 1 ;;
  esac
  archive="node-v${node_version}-linux-${arch}.tar.xz"
  tmp="$(mktemp -d)"
  trap 'rm -rf "$tmp"' EXIT
  echo "Installing Node ${node_version}"
  curl -fsSL "https://nodejs.org/dist/v${node_version}/${archive}" -o "${tmp}/${archive}"
  curl -fsSL "https://nodejs.org/dist/v${node_version}/SHASUMS256.txt" -o "${tmp}/SHASUMS256.txt"
  (cd "$tmp" && grep "  ${archive}\$" SHASUMS256.txt | sha256sum --check --strict --quiet)
  sudo mkdir -p "/opt/node-v${node_version}"
  sudo tar -xJf "${tmp}/${archive}" -C "/opt/node-v${node_version}" --strip-components=1
  for bin in node npm npx corepack; do
    sudo ln -sfn "/opt/node-v${node_version}/bin/${bin}" "/usr/local/bin/${bin}"
  done
fi

# 2. Dependencies, when the lockfile changed since the last install.
if [[ ! -f node_modules/.package-lock.json || package-lock.json -nt node_modules/.package-lock.json ]]; then
  npm ci --no-audit --no-fund
fi

# Outside a Scotty session there is nothing to preview.
if [[ -z "${SCOTTY_HATCH:-}" ]]; then exit 0; fi

# 3. The UI dev server, which serves seed data at /api.
logs=/workspace/.scotty/logs
mkdir -p "$logs"
if ! curl -fs "localhost:${port}" > /dev/null; then
  # The workspace's own script, so the flags reach vite; through `ui:dev` npm eats them.
  setsid nohup npm run dev --workspace @scotty/ui -- --host 0.0.0.0 --strictPort \
    > "${logs}/ui.log" 2>&1 < /dev/null &
fi

# 4. Always last.
for _ in $(seq 120); do curl -fs "localhost:${port}" > /dev/null && break; sleep 1; done
if ! curl -fs "localhost:${port}" > /dev/null; then
  echo "The UI dev server did not answer on ${port} in 120 s:" >&2
  tail -20 "${logs}/ui.log" >&2
  exit 1
fi
echo "Ready: ${SCOTTY_HATCH/\{port\}/${port}}"
